Name: Harvest Moon FOMT's Seeds and Crops
Author: Omnivorse
Description:
[b]Adds all 15 crops from Harvest Moon: Friends of Mineral Town![/b]
If you felt a little nostalgic and wanted to be able to buy those seeds and plant them in SV, this is the mod for you!

[size=4][b]Spring:[/b] Turnip, Potato, Cucumber, Strawberry, Cabbage.
[b]Summer:[/b] Tomato, Corn, Onion, Pumpkin, Pineapple.
[b]Fall:[/b] Carrot, Eggplant, Sweet Potato, Spinach, Green Pepper.

[b]Seeds are sold at Pierre's shop during their respective seasons.[/b][/size]

The pricing and sell values of the crops and seeds have been nerfed and adjusted from that of Harvest Moon / Story of Seasons, just to maintain [i]some[/i] balance (emphasis on some). Crop descriptions are taken and adapted from the Rune Factory series.

I was searching for a mod that adds Harvest Moon crops to SV, and I came across ElderMartins's mod. It inspired me to try and learn SV modding for the first time ever.
I love both Harvest Moon and Stardew Valley (and farming sims in general), so why not combine them both this way?

This is a Content Patcher mod, so it should be safe to install. Of course, make sure to make save backups for safety's sake. 
Simply extract it to your Mods' folder. [b]I will assume you're already familiar with installing mods, SMAPI, and Content Patcher.[/b]

This is my first mod ever, so there may be some bugs I missed. Feel free to share it with me if you encounter any bugs using the mod!
Unsure if there will be plans to do more with this mod, I may add a custom grass seed that could serve as source for hay... maybe add blue variations of the crops for Winter? Well, we'll see!

[size=4][b]Tested using Stardew Valley 1.6, SMAPI 4.4.0, and Content Patcher 2.9.0.[/b][/size]
